desc: Read the input values $N$, $M$, and the list of costs $P$.
Sort the list of costs $P$ in ascending order.
Implement binary search on the marginal cost threshold $T$ to find the maximum $T$ such that the total cost of all units with marginal cost $\le T$ is $\le M$.
Calculate the total units bought with threshold $T$ and the remaining budget.
Calculate how many additional units can be bought with the remaining budget using units with marginal cost $T+1$.
Write the complete Python code, ensuring efficient I/O and logic, then execute it.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Test edge cases (e.g., $M$ very small, $P_i$ very large, $N=1$).
Ensure no Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on maximum constraints.
